rationale: Both Arya and Kevin are actively shipping AI agents and tools in San Francisco with complementary expertise—Arya is building agentic search and mobile control interfaces for AI agents, while Kevin is shipping AI agents and developer tools at PayPal with deep experience in ML observability and compliance systems.
